attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: llm_text_cleanup_via_fastapi_proxy
steps:
  - id: step_receive_extracted_text
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/pwa/extracted-text"
      method: "POST"
    output: raw_request

  - id: step_validate_request_schema
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_request
      schema: extracted_text_request_schema
    output: validated_request

  - id: step_check_cors_origin
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "request.origin == 'https://<username>.github.io'"
      input: validated_request
    output: cors_check_result

  - id: step_handle_cors_rejection
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "cors_check_result.passed == false"
      target: step_terminate_rejected

  - id: step_extract_text_body
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_request
      field: "text"
    output: extracted_text

  - id: step_authenticate_proxy
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "fastapi_proxy_service"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_forward_to_llm
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: extracted_text
      url: "https://llm-api.example.com/v1/chat/completions"
      method: "POST"
      headers:
        Content-Type: "application/json"
      body:
        system_prompt: "Tu es un assistant de nettoyage de texte français. Supprime les numéros de page, les en-têtes courants, les notes de bas de page et les artefacts de césure. Retourne uniquement le texte nettoyé."
        user_message: extracted_text
    output: raw_llm_response

  - id: step_validate_llm_response
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_llm_response
      schema: llm_cleanup_response_schema
    output: validated_llm_response

  - id: step_extract_cleaned_text
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_llm_response
      field: "choices[0].message.content"
    output: cleaned_text

  - id: step_format_response
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: cleaned_text
      format: "json"
      template:
        cleaned_text: cleaned_text
        status: "success"
    output: formatted_response

  - id: step_log_cleanup_request
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: formatted_response
      event: "llm_text_cleanup_completed"
      detail: "Text cleanup proxy request processed successfully"

  - id: step_return_to_pwa
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: formatted_response
      url: "callback"
      method: "RESPONSE"
    output: pwa_delivery_result

  - id: step_handle_errors
    op: handle_error
    params:
      on_error: step_terminate_error
      scope:
        - step_forward_to_llm
        - step_validate_llm_response

  - id: step_retry_llm_call
    op: retry_step
    params:
      step: step_forward_to_llm
      max_retries: 2
      backoff: "exponential"

  - id: step_terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "success"
      message: "Cleaned text returned to PWA for TTS playback"

  - id: step_terminate_rejected
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "rejected"
      message: "Request rejected: CORS origin not allowed"

  - id: step_terminate_error
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "error"
      message: "LLM cleanup proxy encountered an unrecoverable error"
